transcript: You don't need to book a Tatkal ticket now. AI will do it for you. Here is how. Train Tatkal booking opens at 11:00 AM. So I told ChatGPT 6 Astra one simple thing. Run at 10 hours, 59 minutes and 50 seconds. It created a schedule on its own. At exactly 11:00, it opened the IRCTC website by itself. It picked the stations, it picked the date, it picked Tatkal category. It filled in everything. Then like always, the IRCTC website crashed. But it didn't give up. It waited 10 seconds and refreshed. The moment the site came back, it entered all my details and made the final payment. I had already added money to my IRCTC wallet, so it paid from there. Then it gave me a full summary of everything it did, and here's my ticket. And if you want to try this yourself, just comment Ticket, and I'll DM you the exact prompt.
caption:
